# LIVORA — Luxury Custom Wallpapers & Made-to-Measure Murals

> LIVORA (https://livorawallcovering.com) is a premier Indian custom wallpaper and wall mural studio based in Katraj, Pune, Maharashtra. LIVORA manufactures customized made-to-order wall coverings starting at ₹40/sqft with PAN-India express delivery and organic, non-toxic eco latex inks.

- **Delivery Coverage**: All across India (Pune, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Surat, etc.)

## Popular Wallpaper Themes
- **Pichwai & Temple Art**: Traditional Shrinathji cows, lotus ponds, and sanctum temple art.
- **Boho Tales & Modern Minimal**: Earthy bohemian arches, botanical line art, and Scandinavian aesthetics.
- **Tropical Heaven & Forest Murals**: Lush palm fronds, rainforest fauna, and exotic botanical gardens.
- **Wings & Petals**: Chinoiserie cranes, peacocks, floral bouquets, and blooming cherry blossoms.
- **Leafy Bedrooms & Foliage**: Calming sage green foliage, Eucalyptus, and biophilic bedroom designs.
- **Kids Educational & Fun**: World maps, cute wildlife, space galaxy, and Scandinavian nursery decor.

## Features & Ordering Process
- **Made-to-Measure**: Customers enter exact wall width and height in inches or centimeters; total square footage and price are calculated in real time.
- **Eco-Friendly Inks**: 100% odorless, non-toxic, safe for bedrooms, nurseries, and hospitals.
- **Pan-India Express Shipping**: Safe protective tube packaging with rapid doorstep delivery.
